policy: A source-category hit is never sufficient by itself. ADMIT_EXACT requires release-safe materialized evidence plus source-page semantics that directly support the frozen ECHO target. KEEP_REVIEW_REQUIRED is the default for generic alarms, sirens, braking/maneuver names, synthesized/effect ambiguity or composite events lacking an isolated target claim. Recording-family decisions are conservative and may reduce group credit when clips are clearly from one session/series.
